title: Patch: Back in a live online match asks first, and says how long you have to come back
thread:
**Issue #2479 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #2479: Patch: Back in a live online match asks first, and says how long you have to come back Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means In an online match, the Back button above the board leaves at once, and so does the phone's back gesture. Nothing asks first, and nothing says what follows: if the player isn't back within 60 seconds, the match counts as a loss. Practice already asks 'Leave this game?', and Concede asks too. Once this is built, Back during a live match asks: 'Leave the match? It goes on without you. Come back within 60 seconds or it counts as a loss.' Stay is the default. Once the game is over, Back leaves at once, as it does now. ## Why - The match screen's rail draws `` (`apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx:569`). A press calls `navigate(to)` at once (`apps/web/src/routes/nav.tsx:56-63`). - Leaving the route closes the socket (`apps/web/src/game/net.ts:864`, `live.close(1000, 'leaving the match')`), and the server starts the disconnect grace. §9.5 (`spec/09-architecture.md:64`): 'Disconnect grace (60 s) and concede end the match as a loss'. - The client already has the tool. `guardLeaving` (R1754000, `apps/web/src/net/navigate.ts:43`) holds every `navigate` and every `popstate` off a page until the page lets the player go. Only the creator uses it (`apps/web/src/routes/creator.tsx:43`). - R765 gives practice its 'Leave this game?' question and the menus a Rejoin banner. A live online match gets no question and no word of the 60 seconds. ## Proposal - While the view has no result (`view.result === null`), `match.tsx` registers `guardLeaving`. A held move opens a small dialog built like `ConfirmConcede` (`apps/web/src/game/ConfirmConcede.tsx`). - Its words: 'Leave the match? It goes on without you. Come back within {seconds} seconds or it counts as a loss.' `{seconds}` is `DISCONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS` from the generated server config. - Its answers: Stay, which is focused and is Escape's answer, and Leave, which makes the held move. - The guard is released once the view has a result, and on unmount. - The co-op table is left out. There a disconnect hands the seat to the AI rather than losing (§13.8), so it needs other words, and it can follow later. - A new ruling amends R765 for online matches. The strings get their zh-CN entries. ## Where it lands - `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx`, a new dialog under `apps/web/src/game/`, and the i18n catalog. - §9.5 (`spec/09-architecture.md`), with a ruling note and `spec/pending/.md`. - Tests in `apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx`. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] In a live match, pressing Back shows the dialog and the path stays `/match/`. Stay closes it and sends nothing; Leave goes to the menu. - [ ] A browser Back (`popstate`) during a live match is held the same way. - [ ] Once the view has a result, Back leaves at once with no dialog. - [ ] The number in the words comes from `DISCONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS`, not a literal (CLAUDE.md rule 9). - [ ] The dialog opens with the focus on Stay, and Escape answers Stay. - [ ] The tests are named after the new ruling, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes. ## Size and risks Medium: about 150 lines plus tests. Only one page holds the guard at a time (`navigate.ts`), so the match screen must release it on unmount, or the next page inherits it. A navigation the app makes on its own, such as a forced one, must not be held. `navigate`'s `force` option covers that, and a test should show it. --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it. Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it. ## Plan _Written by `claude-7` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41061030194)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal While `/match/` shows a live view (no result, and a socket that is neither voided nor refused), `guardLeaving` (R1754000) holds every way off the board: the rail's Back, the browser's Back and every unforced `navigate`. A held move opens a new dialog, "Leave the match?", whose words take the grace from `DISCONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS`. Stay has the focus, Escape and Back answer it, and it sends nothing. Leave makes the held move. Once the view has a result, Back leaves at once. The guard is released then and on unmount. Ruling R2479000 amends R765 and §9.5 cites it. The strings get zh-CN entries, and the tests in `match.test.tsx` carry the ruling's name. The co-op table is left out. ## Files to touch | Path | new/change | What | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/game/ConfirmLeaveMatch.tsx` | new | the `ConfirmLeaveMatch` dialog (a copy of `ConfirmConcede.tsx`) and `leaveMatchTestid` | | `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx` | change | `leaving` state, `atStake`, the `guardLeaving` effect, the dialog in the final return | | `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | 3 entries at the end | | `apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx` | change | imports, and a new `describe("R2479000 …")` at the end of the file | | `apps/web/README.md` | change | the `useBackLayer` callers list (line ~97), and a new paragraph after "Concede asks first" (line ~155) | | `spec/rulings/R2479000.md` | new | the ruling note | | `spec/pending/2479.md` | new | its §11 paragraph | | `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | §9.5, the turn-clock bullet: one sentence linking `[[R2479000]]` | Do not touch: - `apps/web/src/net/navigate.ts`, `net/backLayers.ts`, `routes/nav.tsx`, `game/ConfirmConcede.tsx` or `game/notices.css`; - anything under `apps/web/src/duos/`, `crates/` or `apps/web/src/wire/`; - `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md` or `spec/rulings/R0765.md`. Do not run `cargo jackioh spec index`. Governing: §9.5, §13.8 (unchanged), R765, R1754000, R2127000, R711000, and CLAUDE.md rules 3, 7 and 9. ## Steps 1. **Create `apps/web/src/game/ConfirmLeaveMatch.tsx`.** Copy `apps/web/src/game/ConfirmConcede.tsx` and change exactly this: - **Header comment.** Replace all of it with these five lines: ``` // "Leave the match?": what every way off a live online match opens (R2479000). Leaving closes the // match socket, and the server's disconnect grace runs: back within DISCONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS, or the // match counts as a loss (§9.5). Stay is the default: it takes the focus, and Escape, Back (R2127000) // or a click outside the panel means the same. It decides nothing (CLAUDE.md rule 7): Leave makes // the move the route's leave guard held (R1754000). It wears "Concede this game?"'s panel (notices.css). ``` - **Imports.** Drop `import { testid } from "./contract.ts";`. Add `import { DISCONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS } from "@jackioh/server-config";` after the `react` import. Keep the `i18n`, `backLayers` and `"./notices.css"` imports. - **Constants.** Delete `CONCEDE_TITLE` and `CONCEDE_BODY`. Add `export const leaveMatchTestid = { dialog: "leave-match-dialog", stay: "leave-match-stay", leave: "leave-match-leave" } as const;` - **Props.** `export type ConfirmLeaveMatchProps = { /** "Stay", Escape, Back or a click outside the panel. */ onStay(): void; /** "Leave": make the held move. */ onLeave(): void; };` - **Component.** `export default function ConfirmLeaveMatch({ onStay, onLeave }: ConfirmLeaveMatchProps): ReactElement`. - Rename the ref `concede` to `leave`. - Every `onCancel` becomes `onStay`: in `useBackLayer`, in the Escape branch, in the effect's deps (`[onStay]`) and in the scrim's click. - The focus effect and the Tab loop stay as they are. - **JSX.** - Keep every `className` as it is: `concede-scrim`, `concede-dialog`, `concede-dialog__title`, `concede-dialog__body`, `concede-dialog__actions`, `concede-dialog__stay` on Stay and `concede-dialog__concede` on Leave. - The `data-testid`s become `leaveMatchTestid.dialog`, `leaveMatchTestid.stay` and `leaveMatchTestid.leave`. - The title is `{t("Leave the match?")}`. - The body is `{t("It goes on without you. Come back within {seconds} seconds or it counts as a loss.", { seconds: DISCONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS })}`. - The buttons read `{t("Stay")}` (`onClick={onStay}`) and `{t("Leave")}` (`onClick={onLeave}`). - Write these strings inline in `t()`, not through constants, so that `i18n.test.ts` checks their zh-CN entries. 2. **`apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx`**: - **Imports.** Change `import { navigate, paths } from "../net/navigate.ts";` to `import { guardLeaving, navigate, paths } from "../net/navigate.ts";`. Add `import ConfirmLeaveMatch from "../game/ConfirmLeaveMatch.tsx";` after `import Game from "../game/Game.tsx";`. - **State and effect.** In `MatchRoute`, put this right after the `#1792` effect that sets `document.title`, before `if (view === null) {`. Copy it exactly: ```tsx // R2479000: while the match is live, every way off the board (its Back, the browser's Back, any // in-app move but a forced one) asks first and names the disconnect grace (§9.5). A finished, // voided or refused match has nothing to come back to, so it is left at once. const [leaving, setLeaving] = useState<{ leave: () => void } | null>(null); const atStake = view !== null && view.result === null && match.connection !== "closed" && match.connection !== "refused"; useEffect(() => { if (!atStake) return; const release = guardLeaving((leave) => { setLeaving({ leave }); }); return () => { release(); setLeaving(null); }; }, [atStake]); ``` - **The dialog.** In the last `return`, inside the `app-shell` div and after `{board}`, add: ```tsx {leaving === null ? null : ( { setLeaving(null); }} onLeave={leaving.leave} /> )} ``` `onLeave` must be `leaving.leave` itself. Do not call `setLeaving(null)` before it. After a held browser Back the move is a `history.back()`. If the dialog closes first, its back-layer entry is left spent, and that Back would land on the match again. 3. **`apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`.** The last entry is ` "Lost: you conceded": "失败：你认输了"`. Put a comma after it, then add these three lines (the last one has no comma): ``` "Leave the match?": "离开在线对局？", "It goes on without you. Come back within {seconds} seconds or it counts as a loss.": "对局会在没有你的情况下继续。{seconds} 秒内回来，否则算作失败。", "Stay": "留下" ``` `"Leave"` already has an entry; do not add it again. 4. **`spec/rulings/R2479000.md`** (new): ```markdown --- id: R2479000 title: "Back in a live online match asks first, and says how long the player has to come back (issue #2479, amends R765)" cards: "§9.5, §13.8, R79, R765, R1754000, R2127000" proven_in: - apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx --- Amends [[R765]] for online 1v1 matches. While a match's board shows a view with no result, every way off it in the client is held by the page's leave guard ([[R1754000]]): the board's Back, the browser's Back or Android's back gesture, and any other move in the app, such as a link, the command menu, a friend's Watch or a challenge's Accept. Each asks "Leave the match? It goes on without you. Come back within 60 seconds or it counts as a loss." The number is `DISCONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS`, the server's disconnect grace ([[§9.5]], [[R79]]). Stay is the default. It has the focus, Escape, Back ([[R2127000]]) or a click outside the panel means the same, and it sends nothing. Leave makes the move the player took, and the menus' banner offers Rejoin ([[R765]]). A move the client makes for itself (`navigate`'s `force`) is never held. Once the view has a result, or the socket has closed for good (a voided match) or been refused, nothing is left to come back to: every way off goes at once, and a question still open closes. A reload or a closed tab asks nothing, since a reload rejoins the match at once. The co-op table asks nothing yet: there a disconnect hands the seat to the AI rather than losing ([[§13.8]]), which needs other words. Rejected: holding the move before the first view, when the loading panel has no board to leave; and making the held move by itself when the result arrives with the question open, which would leave a board the player could now leave at once. ``` 5. **`spec/pending/2479.md`** (new). One paragraph: ```markdown **[[R2479000]] Back in a live online match asks first (issue #2479, 2026-10-30)**: the board's Back and the browser's Back left a live online match at once, and nothing said that the match goes on and counts as a loss unless the player is back within the disconnect grace. The match screen now holds every way off with the creator's leave guard ([[R1754000]]) and asks, naming `DISCONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS`. A finished, voided or refused match is left at once, and the co-op table is unchanged. It takes R2479000, the first number of issue #2479's block, and amends [[R765]]. ``` 6. **`spec/09-architecture.md`**, §9.5. Find the bullet that starts `- The turn clock (75 s) ends a stalled turn.` and the sentence in it that ends "…ends it as a draw through the `ceilingReached` action." Right after that sentence, insert this, with its leading space: ` In the client every way off a live 1v1 board asks first and names the grace in seconds, and once the match has a result it goes at once ([[R2479000]]).` Change nothing else in the file. 7. **`apps/web/README.md`**: - **Line ~97** (`**Back closes the top overlay**`). In "`SettingsPanel`, `ConfirmConcede`, `PracticeLeave` and `ChatPanel` call", insert `` `ConfirmLeaveMatch`, `` after `` `ConfirmConcede`, ``. - **After the `**Concede asks first**` paragraph** (it ends "…the game's end drops the question."). Add a blank line and this paragraph: ``` **Back in a live online match asks first** (R2479000). While `/match/` shows a view with no result on a socket neither voided nor refused, `routes/match.tsx` holds `guardLeaving`: every way off opens `ConfirmLeaveMatch.tsx`'s `leave-match-dialog`, naming `DISCONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS`. `leave-match-stay` has the focus and is what Escape, Back and a click outside do; `leave-match-leave` makes the held move. A result or leaving the route releases the guard. The co-op board asks nothing. ``` ## Tests `apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx` mocks `navigate` with a bare `vi.fn()`. The new describe puts the real implementation back so that `BackLink` meets the guard. `guardLeaving` and `usePathname` are already real, through the mock's `...actual` spread. **Imports:** - Add `DISCONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS` to the existing `@jackioh/server-config` import. - Change `import { navigate } from "../net/navigate.ts";` to `import { navigate, paths, usePathname } from "../net/navigate.ts";`. - Add `import type { ReactElement } from "react";`, `import { leaveMatchTestid } from "../game/ConfirmLeaveMatch.tsx";` and `import { navTestid } from "./nav.tsx";`. - `VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE` and `FORBIDDEN_CLOSE` (module scope, line ~492) already exist. **The describe.** At the end of the file, add `describe("R2479000 Back in a live online match asks first, and names the disconnect grace", () => { … })`, holding: - ``const WORDS = `It goes on without you. Come back within ${String(DISCONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS)} seconds or it counts as a loss.`;`` and `const AT = paths.match("m-1");` - `function Shell(): ReactElement`. It reads `const path = usePathname();` and returns `path === AT ? :

{path}

`. It is needed because the `popstate` listener exists only while a `usePathname` reader does. - `async function browserBack()`, copied from `apps/web/src/routes/creator.test.tsx`: inside `act`, call `window.history.back()` and wait for one `popstate`. - `beforeEach(async () => { const actual = await vi.importActual("../net/navigate.ts"); vi.mocked(navigate).mockImplementation(actual.navigate); window.history.replaceState(null, "", paths.play); window.history.pushState(null, "", AT); });` - `afterEach(() => { vi.mocked(navigate).mockReset(); });` Each test starts with `render(); attach();`. For a result view, use `const over = baseView({ viewer: "p1", active: "p1", phase: "over", result: { winner: "p2", reason: "hero-death" } });`. 1. **`it("R2479000 the board's Back on a live match asks first and stays; Stay sends nothing, Leave goes to the menu")`** - Note `const sent = live().sent.length`, then click `navTestid.back`. - The dialog shows, and `window.location.pathname` is `AT`. - The dialog has the text `"Leave the match?"` and `WORDS`. - `document.activeElement` is the `leaveMatchTestid.stay` button. - Click Stay: no dialog, path `AT`, and `live().sent` still has length `sent`. - Click Back again, then `leaveMatchTestid.leave`: the path is `paths.landing`, and `elsewhere` has the text `paths.landing`. 2. **`it("R2479000 Escape and the browser's Back on the question answer Stay")`** - Click Back, then `fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: "Escape" })`: no dialog, path `AT`. - Click Back again, then `await browserBack()`: no dialog, path `AT`. 3. **`it("R2479000 the browser's Back off a live match is held the same way, and Leave goes back")`** - `await browserBack()`: the path is `AT` and the dialog shows. - Click Stay, then `await browserBack()` again and `await screen.findByTestId(leaveMatchTestid.dialog)`; the path is `AT`. This Back takes two steps over the dialog's spent back-layer entry, which is why it waits with `findBy`. - Click Leave, then `await waitFor(() => expect(window.location.pathname).toBe(paths.play))`, then `expect(await screen.findByTestId("elsewhere")).toHaveTextContent(paths.play)`. 4. **`it("R2479000 once the view has a result the question closes and Back leaves at once")`** - Click Back: the dialog shows. - `pushView(over)`: no dialog. - Click Back: no dialog, and the path is `paths.landing`. 5. **`it("R2479000 a match voided or refused mid-game is left at once")`** - `act(() => { live().onclose?.({ code: VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE, reason: "voided", wasClean: true }); })`, then click Back: no dialog, path `paths.landing`. - Then `act(() => { navigate(AT); })`, `attach()`, and `act(() => { live().onclose?.({ code: FORBIDDEN_CLOSE, reason: "", wasClean: true }); })`. Wrap this refused part in `vi.spyOn(console, "error").mockImplementation(() => undefined)` and restore it in `finally`, as the refused test at line ~1357 does. - Click Back: no dialog, path `paths.landing`. 6. **`it("R2479000 a forced move goes at once, an unforced one is held, and the guard leaves with the route")`** - `act(() => { navigate(paths.together); })`: the dialog shows, and the path is `AT`. Click Stay. - `act(() => { navigate(paths.play, { force: true }); })`: the path is `paths.play`, there is no dialog, and `elsewhere` shows. - `act(() => { navigate(paths.landing); })`: the path is `paths.landing`, so no guard was left over. **Commands:** ``` sh scripts/build-wasm.sh pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/routes/match.test.tsx src/i18n/i18n.test.ts src/game/ConfirmConcede.test.tsx src/net/navigate.test.tsx src/net/backLayers.test.tsx src/routes/creator.test.tsx pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx apps/web/src/game/ConfirmLeaveMatch.tsx cargo jackioh spec check ``` ## Done when - [ ] Back on a live match shows `leave-match-dialog` and the path does not change. Stay closes it and sends nothing; Leave goes to `/` (test 1). - [ ] A browser Back is held the same way (test 3). - [ ] Stay has the focus when the dialog opens, and Escape and Back answer Stay (tests 1, 2). - [ ] With a result, Back leaves at once and a question still open closes (test 4). - [ ] A voided or refused match is left at once (test 5). - [ ] A forced `navigate` is not held, and unmount releases the guard (test 6). - [ ] No literal 60 in code: the words read `DISCONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS` (rule 9). - [ ] The commands above and the harness's checks pass. - [ ] `git status` shows only the 8 files in the table. ## Risks - **A guard left behind.** Only one page holds the guard at a time, so the effect's cleanup must call `release()` (test 6). - **Hook order.** The new `useState` and `useEffect` must sit above `if (view === null)`, or React throws on the first view. - **The held browser Back.** Use `onLeave={leaving.leave}` exactly; test 3 fails if the dialog closes first. I checked this history sequence in a throwaway test against `ConfirmConcede`, along with the mock swap and the rail's Back on a finished match. All of it passed, and I deleted the test afterwards. - **Existing tests.** They keep the bare `vi.fn()` `navigate`. Only the new describe swaps in the real one, and it resets it after each test. Keep the describe last in the file, because it moves `window.location`. `match.test.tsx` passes on the base (64 tests). - **Rule 7.** The dialog reads nothing from the view and sends nothing. Leaving only unmounts the route, which closes the socket as it did before. - **i18n.** `i18n.test.ts` fails on a `t()` literal with no zh-CN entry, or on a `{seconds}` mismatch. Copy the keys byte for byte. - **e2e.** No spec leaves a live match by either Back: spec 19 uses `cy.visit("/")`, a full page load the guard never sees. If a spec does hit `leave-match-dialog`, report it; do not change e2e. ## Open questions None of these block the build. The issue left these decisions open; the ruling records each one: - **Voided or refused socket:** left at once. Otherwise the voided notice's "Back to the lobby" would ask about a match that no longer exists. - **Before the first view:** nothing is held. - **A result arriving while the question is open:** it closes the question instead of making the held move. - **Reload or closed tab:** no `beforeunload` prompt, since a reload rejoins the match. - **Leave button:** reuses the existing "Leave" string and Concede's red button. --- Comment by @MaxGoetzmann at 2026-10-30T13:03:04Z: Approve ````
